name: quantize_per_tensor
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::quantize_per_tensor(Tensor self, float scale, int zero_point, ScalarType dtype) -> Tensor. Quantizes a float32 tensor with one scale and zero point. The suite covers supported quantized dtypes, scalar and multidimensional shapes, clamping, tie rounding, memory formats, noncontiguous inputs, invalid parameters, and the quantize_per_tensor.out identity, storage, layout, and rejection contracts.
